scenes.headline: Unity Catalog
scenes.subtitle: One governance layer across all workspaces
scenes.narration: Unity Catalog provides centralized governance, lineage, and discovery for data and AI assets across Databricks.

scenes.headline: What Unity Catalog governs
items: Fine-grained grants, row filters, and masks
Tables, views, volumes, models, and functions
scenes.narration: Unity Catalog organizes assets in a consistent catalog, schema, and table hierarchy. It centralizes access control including row filters and column masks. Its scope spans not just tables but files, models, and functions too.

scenes.headline: Governing with Unity Catalog
scenes.narration: We create a governed catalog and schema for production sales data. A group grant gives analysts read access across that schema. Tagging the customers table as PII aids classification and discovery.

scenes.headline: Automatic lineage
scenes.narration: As jobs and queries execute, Unity Catalog records what they read and write. It assembles this into an end-to-end lineage graph. Teams can then trace how data flows down to the column level.

scenes.headline: Why it matters
items: One consistent model across all workspaces
Search and discovery to find trusted data
scenes.narration: A single governance model removes per-workspace inconsistency. Automatic lineage answers impact and audit questions without manual tracking. Built-in search helps users discover and trust the data they need.

scenes.text: Unity Catalog is the single pane of governance, lineage, and discovery for the lakehouse.
scenes.narration: Govern once at the account level, and every workspace inherits consistent, auditable control.
